visual_type: exact data plan, not game screenshot

visual_review.finding: Different family footprints: city roadside trio, unequal three-group pack and undead territory, two separated spider broods, staggered desert pairs, two cold-region groups. Final live decoration anchors match resident indices, with no 600px soft-threshold warnings.
visual_review.terrain_context: Relief groups use open flanks and approach corridors next to the real UI29 polygons; selected group anchors are 41–666px outside their own patch, homes up to904px. City encounters intentionally follow city roads and outskirts. This is adjacent terrain context, not a promise that all homes sit inside one polygon.
visual_review.ranged_placement: Selected bandit, undead and ice ranged residents are deeper from the road on average than melee residents: respectively809vs665,1427vs1239,1015vs959px.
visual_review.layout_variety: Selected scenes use1,2 or3group centers. Three-group normalized side signatures differ:[0.39,0.84,1.0]for wolves and[0.62,0.64,1.0]for undead. No common equilateral or shared triangle footprint in the six examples.
visual_review.plan_limit: Plans show exact home positions; dot size is schematic. They do not show animated roaming or the game HUD.
